answer: Price seats by arithmetic, not identity: every epoch the chain burns a recurring fee c per live seat and splits a fixed pool P equally — no issuer's quill or bond is trusted; the ledger is the rule. Extra masks dilute their own claim: N attack seats earn P·N/(H+N), the marginal seat P·H/(H+N)², so seats beyond N* = √(PH/c) − H lose. The fee recurs per seat, saffron-priced, over the same horizon as rewards; splitting into sub-farms cannot dodge it — the bound counts all attack seats. Honest limit: c ≥ P/H deters fully but starves honest seats; thin honest pools weaken it.
